nom: Dermalogica Phyto Nature E² Regenerating Daily Exosome Leave-On Treatment

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin that leans oily reports fading fine lines and improved elasticity, and another with oily-dehydrated skin found the formula light enough not to feel suffocating under layers.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the treatment leaves skin soft, nourished and smoother, with fading fine lines and no reports of irritation.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who also describes it as acne-prone, report softer, more even skin and fading fine lines without breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with extremely sensitive skin and one managing rosacea, report the treatment did not sting or irritate and, for the rosacea reviewer, helped keep symptoms more under control.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report softer, smoother fine lines and firmer-looking skin within one to a few weeks of use, some describing dramatic reductions in forehead lines or crow's feet within days; a minority of reviewers, including one who used it for several weeks, report no major improvement despite the price.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the treatment as hydrating and plumping, with skin feeling moisturized rather than dry even with twice-daily use; no reviewer in this set reports dryness or tightness from the product itself.
concerns.redness: One reviewer managing rosacea reports her skin looked smoother and more controlled after adding the treatment; no reviewer reports increased redness or irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or combination/acne-prone report no new breakouts and smoother-looking skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the treatment helped fade dark spots from sun exposure; this is the only mention of pigmentation in the set.

aspects.libelle: Can feel tacky or sticky right after application
Layers well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: I enjoy how gentle AND effective Dermalogica products are, and the E2 is the same! It is a very gentle exfoliant, and while fragrance free the natural scent reminds me of the peel-foliant, maybe it's the fruit enzymes? I have very sensitive skin and only use it every other day it and it great. I have smooth skin as a result, and I'm excited to see what a full bottle of exosomes can do. It also does help keep the oils at bay during the day Gifted by Dermalogica for review

gifted by dermalogica complimentary of dermalogica I've been using the Phyto Nature E² Regenerating Daily Exosome Leave-On Treatment twice a day since late November, and I can honestly say this product delivers. I was hesitant about the price at first, but the results make it completely worth it. I'm in my mid-thirties with combination skin, and this treatment has become one of the few products I can genuinely recommend without hesitation. Within a couple of weeks, I noticed a visible softening of fine lines and an overall smoother, brighter look to my skin. The exfoliating enzymes gently clear away dull surface cells, while the exosome blend works deeper to support firmness and renewal. My skin looks more refreshed, more even, and noticeably more resilient day to day. If you're dealing with mature or prematurely aging skin, fine lines, wrinkles, or a loss of firmness, this is absolutely worth considering. It's lightweight, silky, and truly feels like it reawakens your skin's natural renewal process. I love this product and plan to keep it in my routine long-term.

This was gifted by Dermalogica. I really loved using this. Has someone that has dry skin and starting to see aging lines on my face this has been a life saver! This really helped my skin stay soft and I could tell on my crows feet and smil lines that they are starting to fade. This is very easy to apply and the texture is thick and able to blend into my skin well. I can use it morning and evening and it does not irate my skin. Definitely i product i highly recommend!

extraits.titre: Fine lines have visibly faded! Dullness has subsided!
extraits.texte: I have combination skin (mostly oily ) and my skin shows visible signs of aging. Fine lines, lack of elasticity and dullness are some of my primary skin concerns. I was on the lookout for a serum that is crafted for aging and dull skin and I was intrigued to try the Phyto Nature E² serum by Dermalogica! The first thing I noticed about the product was the smooth gel like consistency. The absorption was magical and the hydration effect was almost instant. I started using it twice daily , as recommended. After consistent use , my skin's elasticity has visibly improved and the fine lines have faded considerably. I like how supple my skin looks and feels. I use it before I start my makeup too and it layers perfectly without making my skin feel weighed down or greasy. My dullness has subsided and I love the healthy shine. A small amount goes a long way and nourishes my skin from within. Perfect product for aging skin.I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica and I am happy to present my honest review!

Absolutely loved this serum for my acne prone dehydrated skin. First of all- it didn't cause any irritation/clogged pores. My skin was looking and feeling so hydrated and plump even after the first use. A week later it looked even better and more youthful. 10/10 This product was gifted to me by dermalogica.

I've been using this for around a month and it has made a notable difference in my skin. Now, I honestly can't tell a difference in fine lines/wrinkles yet but my rosacea is more under control, and my skin looks smoother, brighter, and more clear. I'm hoping I eventually see some difference in fine lines/wrinkles. I also just want to add that I have extremely sensitive skin and almost all products sting/burn my skin…even gentle mositurizers like cerave and cetaphil. This does not burn at all and is very gentle.

Happy to have this treatment/serum gifted by Dermalogica. I use a few Dermalogica products already and all are working well on me. This treatment is a watery gel that is lightweight and absorbs almost instantly. It's really light, my oily-dehydrated skin doesn't feel suffocated with layering this plus 1 or 2 other serums, moisturizer, sunscreen, and makeup. It's formulated with gentle exfoliants, probiotic, and natural moisturizing factors. I like to use it in the mornings and on non-retinoid nights. I don't get any tingling or irritation from this. It's gentle, has my favorite light and non-sticky texture, and contains notable ingredients and formula. This is another winner from the brand.
